title: [BOUNTY] Miner Leaderboard — Top Earners & Hardware Showcase (20 RTC)
description: ## Miner Leaderboard — 20 RTC Bounty  Build a live leaderboard showing the top RTC earners and the most interesting hardware on the network. Gamification drives engagement.  ### What It Shows  **Leaderboard Table:** | Rank | Miner | Hardware | Multiplier | Epochs Active | Est.
